name: COMP_043
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (71%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Flagged frozen-section reliability, three-class conformal ambiguity, and model disagreement require recut H&E, deeper levels, and deferred margins [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 71%, Benign 17%, Normal 7%, Invasive 5% [F1] | Favors InSitu; low invasive risk |
| Conformal set | Normal, Benign, InSitu (90% target; 90% test coverage, n=132) | Cannot separate non-invasive classes |
| Reliability / OOD | Reliability 21% (flagged), OOD 84th percentile, 12/12 tiles [F6] | Suspect input; atypical frozen section |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class (false) | Independent foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 3/5 (60%) InSitu [F5]; 1 Invasive (BACH_0278, 88%), 1 Normal (88%) | Mixed neighbors include invasive match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 6, 10) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score (+0.73 contribution) pushes toward invasion (19/20 check) [F2] · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 2, 3, 7) · ↓ invasive · Negative pull (-0.55), but unreliable (0/20 AI spot check) [F3] · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical confinement (+0.33 contribution) raises invasive score (12/20 check) [F4] · Weak
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 4, 8, 10) · ↑ invasive · High atypia (+0.30 contribution; 18/20 check); separates invasive neighbor BACH_0278 · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 6) · context · Descriptive stromal score only (-0.28 contribution; 8/20 spot check) · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top-3 risk regions beats random deletion (+0.011, 95% CI 0.002–0.020, n=132), confirming classifier faithfulness.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI spans zero (-0.009–0.006), unverified for classifier use; relies on unreliable normal lobules (0/20) and mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- High-risk regions 8 (97%), 11 (95%), 10 (65%), and 6 (37%) harbor invasion like neighbor BACH_0278 (88% similar).
- Frozen-section artifact (reliability 21%, test AUROC 70%) mimics atypia; Normal (7%) and Benign (17%) remain in the conformal set.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 11, 10, 6**: Highest risk tiles (97%, 95%, 65%, 37%); assess stromal invasion versus duct confinement.
2. **Regions 2, 3, 7**: Confirm normal lobules and benign stroma; review drafted recut H&E and deeper levels.
3. **Regions 1, 4, 8, 11**: Defer frozen margins (inferior/medial/lateral 100%, superior 93%); permanent sections needed (cells disabled).
